item.title: 计算 q-Pareto 分布的最大似然估计及其在地震中的应用
item.description: On computing the maximum likelihood estimates for the q-Pareto distribution and application to earthquakes Fatah Benatia and Mohammed Ridha Kouider 副词。统计。 Clim. Meteorol. Oceanogr., 12, 211–219, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-211-2026, 2026 The aim of this study is to develop efficient estimation methods of the maximum likelihood estimation method for the q-Pareto distribution (q-PD) parameters that are based on numerical methods to maximize the log-likelihood of the q-PD. And the q-PD parameters is a q-exponential distribution, finding applications in many fields such as: seismology (earthquake patterns).

item.title: 用于估算气候变化下的设计海况的非平稳 GEV 模型——在法国海岸海上风电场的应用
item.description: 用于估算气候变化下的设计海况的非平稳GEV模型——在法国海岸海上风电场的应用 Nicolas Raillard, Coline Poppeschi, Tessa Chevallier, Youen Kervella, and Laurent Dubus 副词。统计。 Clim. Meteorol. Oceanogr., 12, 195–210, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-195-2026, 2026 This study examines how ocean wave conditions around France may change as the climate warms.使用新的统计方法和多种气候预测，它表明极端波浪可能在冬季变得更加强烈，在夏季变得不那么严重，特别是在大西洋沿岸和英吉利海峡。 The work also proposes a new way to define extreme sea-state conditions over the structure's lifetime, leading to better design.

利用深度学习和卫星数据进行智能每日降雨量预测以进行早期预警：在科特迪瓦布瓦夫莱和祖埃努拉站的应用 Satti J. R. Kamenan, Ta M. Youan, Miessan G. Adja, Sandona I. Soro, and Amani M. Kouassi 副词。统计。 Clim. Meteorol. Oceanogr., 12, 173–193, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-173-2026, 2026 Recurrent flooding in the Marahoué region, especially at Bouaflé and Zuénoula, requires reliable rainfall forecasts. This study uses deep learning with satellite data to predict daily rainfall up to seven days ahead.结果显示短期和中期预报的准确性很高，支持早期预警系统并帮助当地社区为洪水风险做好准备。

基于广义线性模型改进多站点降水发生器 雅各布·本杰明·韦塞尔和理查德·E·钱德勒 副词。统计。 Clim. Meteorol.海洋学, 12, 149–172, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-149-2026, 2026 降水生成器是用于生成用于水文分析的（多地点）降水长合成序列的统计模型。一类广泛使用的降水发生器基于所谓的“广义线性模型”。 在这项工作中，我们扩展了此类，以更好地捕获每日降水的关键特征，并引入一种新方法来确保现实的站点间依赖性，因此相邻位置往往同时干燥或潮湿。

item.title: 海洋气象数据中极端泛函的模拟：在潮汐周期中潮汐演化中的应用
item.description: 海洋气象数据中极端泛函的模拟：潮汐周期潮汐演化的应用 内森·戈尔斯、奥利维尔·鲁斯坦、杰里米·侯麦和黛博拉·伊迪尔 副词。统计。 Clim. Meteorol.海洋学, 12, 123–148, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-123-2026, 2026 The analysis of the effect of extreme meteoceanic conditions is usually based on physical simulators, which rely on simulated extreme inputs consistent with the observations.然而，浪涌测量常常无法满足理论假设。 To address this, we propose a new simulation method which makes it possible to adjust the desired level of extremes after retrieving standard hypotheses.然后使用多种工具验证模拟与观察的一致性。

item.title: 卫星时间序列中基于 NDVI 的烧伤疤痕持久性的鲁棒双删失威布尔模型
item.description:
Robust doubly censored Weibull modelling of NDVI-based burn-scar persistence in satellite time series 诺拉·哈利勒 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。 Oceanogr., 12, 111–121, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-111-2026, 2026
Wildfires leave scars on the land that slowly fade as vegetation grows back.利用阿拉斯加卫星图像的长期记录，我们测量了烧毁地区明显受损的时间，并建立了一个统计模型来描述其恢复情况。 We find that most areas recover in about three years, while some remain scarred for five to six years. Our approach can be reused to track recovery after other environmental disturbances.

item.title: 选择最佳分布来模拟气候变化下低、中和极端日降水量的趋势
item.description: 选择气候变化下低、中、极端日降水量趋势建模的最佳分布 阿布巴卡尔·哈鲁纳、朱丽叶·布兰切特、纪尧姆·埃文和伊曼纽尔·帕奎特 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。海洋学, 12, 87–109, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-87-2026, 2026 这项研究通过使用单一、灵活的分布来分析整个每日范围内的趋势，从而推进了非平稳降水建模。我们证明，不断变化的形状参数对于准确捕获观察到的低、中和极端分位数的差异变化至关重要。该方法确保统计一致性，为气候影响分析中常见的两部分框架提供可靠的趋势评估。

item.title: 比较气候时间序列 - 第 6 部分：在不假设噪声方差相等的情况下测试自回归参数的相等性
item.description: Comparing climate time series – Part 6: Testing equality of autoregressive parameters without assuming equality of noise variances 蒂莫西·德尔索尔和迈克尔·K·蒂皮特 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。海洋学, 12, 73–86, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-73-2026, 2026 We derived a new statistical test that can compare climate models and observations more broadly than before, while allowing for both natural fluctuations and human influences.对全球温度数据的测试表明，大多数气候模型在重要方面与观测结果存在差异。

item.title: 根据缺失样本的均匀间隔数据对功率谱密度进行渐近无偏非参数估计
item.description: 从具有缺失样本的均匀间隔数据中进行功率谱密度的渐近无偏非参数估计 塞德里克·查瓦纳 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。 Oceanogr., 12, 59–72, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-59-2026, 2026 Standard algorithms for estimating the power spectral density of finite discrete data require interpolating missing samples, which usually produces biased estimates. An unbiased estimate can be obtained by taking the Fourier transform of the unbiased estimator of the circular autocorrelation, using only the available data. With missing samples, this estimator can produce negative power spectral densities, but converges to positive values when averaged over a sufficient number of realizations.

item.title: 上个千年基于树木年轮的重建对温度和降水的联合概率估计
item.description: Joint probabilistic estimates of temperature and precipitation from tree ring-based reconstructions of the last millennium Kate Marvel, Benjamin Cook, Ensheng Weng, Ram Singh, and Edward Cook 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。 Oceanogr., 12, 43–57, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-43-2026, 2026 Using information derived from tree-rings, we reconstruct possible combinations of past temperatures and precipitation amounts. This lets us put current changes in context and shows, for example, that the 1930s were likely the driest decade on record in central Kansas, while the late 20th century was likely the wettest period on record in the North American southwest.

item.title: 揭示浮游植物对海滨适应的统计方法
item.description: 揭示浮游植物对海滨适应的统计方法 Théo Garcia, Laurina Oms, Xavier Milhaud, Andrea M. Doglioli, Monique Messié, Pierre Vandekerkhove, Claire Lacour, Gérald Grégori, and Denys Pommeret 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。 Oceanogr., 12, 21–41, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-21-2026, 2026 我们研究了地中海微小、短暂的海洋特征如何影响支持海洋生命的微观植物群落。使用新的统计方法，我们发现强有力的证据表明这些特征可以容纳周围水域中未发现的独特群落。 This discovery helps us better understand the role of ocean dynamics in shaping marine ecosystems, even when data are limited and conditions vary widely.

item.title: 使用气候模型大集合对强度-持续时间-频率曲线进行贝叶斯分层建模
item.description: 使用气候模型大型集合对强度-持续时间-频率曲线进行贝叶斯分层建模 亚历山大·李·里斯穆勒、本杰明·波什洛德和贾娜·西尔曼 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。海洋学，12, 1–19, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-12-1-2026, 2026 极端降水概率估算对于灾害防护设计至关重要，但具有较高的不确定性。我们使用 2000 年的气候数据测试了六种统计模型。 Our Bayesian hierarchical duration-dependent Generalized Extreme Value model shows the highest accuracy and robustness for sample sizes between 30 and 100 years, making it highly promising for use with limited observational records.

item.title: 2018 年瑞典极端温暖条件下的土壤湿度-温度耦合：WRF-CTSM 的案例研究
item.description: 2018年瑞典极端温暖条件下的土壤水温耦合：WRF-CTSM案例研究 Iris Mužić、Øivind Hodnebrog、Yeliz A. Yilmaz、Terje K. Berntsen、Jana Sillmann、David M. Lawrence 和 Paul A. Dirmeyer 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。海洋学, 11, 273–292, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-11-273-2025, 2025 This study investigates soil moisture–temperature coupling during the extreme warm conditions in May–August 2018 in southern and central Sweden using the merged GLEAM-E-OBS dataset and four simulations from the Weather Research and Forecasting model coupled with the Community Terrestrial Systems Model (WRF-CTSM). Based on changes in surface soil moisture, evaporative fraction, and daily maximum 2 m temperature, on average across the region and five datasets, the coupling lasted for 22 d.

item.title: 双层时空聚类方法及其在干旱提取中的应用
item.description:
双层时空聚类方法及其在干旱提取中的应用 T. Elana Christian、Amit N. Subrahmanya、Brandi Gamelin、Vishwas Rao、Noelle I. Samia 和 Julie Bessac 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。海洋学, 11, 257–272, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-11-257-2025, 2025
我们提出了一种新颖的时空聚类算法，用于根据强度提取时空事件。 Our algorithm proceeds in two steps: (1) extracting intensity structures that are spatiotemporally consistent and, (2) separating individual events. We apply the algorithm to a novel drought index over the continental United States from 1980–2021 and show that it captures historical drought events over the continental United States and their spatiotemporal extents.

item.title: 使用空间贝叶斯分层极值模型对 COSMO-REA6 阵风进行后处理
item.description: Post-processing of wind gusts from COSMO-REA6 with a spatial Bayesian hierarchical extreme value model 菲利普·埃尔茨和佩特拉·弗里德里希 副词。统计。爬升。梅泰罗尔。海洋学, 11, 229–256, https://doi.org/10.5194/ascmo-11-229-2025, 2025 我们对德国地区的阵风观测进行了空间统计校准，并对未观测到的位置进行了插值。 Furthermore, the model is spatially adaptive and includes the station altitude both as explanatory variable and as offset to increase the distance between stations.这种偏移量使我们能够将山地站纳入训练数据中。与空间恒定模型相比，自适应模型改进了极端阵风的表示。
